dedupe_keys.name: history of industrial control system cyber incidents inl 2018

description: This Idaho National Laboratory report compiles a chronological timeline of significant, publicly reported cyber incidents and threats against the industrial control systems that operate critical infrastructure. It covers 23 events from 1903 to 2017, including the Maroochy Water attack in 2000, Stuxnet, Shamoon, the New York dam intrusion, the German steel mill attack, the 2015 and 2016 Ukraine power grid attacks, CRASHOVERRIDE, NotPetya and TRITON, with a summary timeline table and a narrative section on each event. It was written by K. E. Hemsley and R. E. Fisher of INL (report INL/CON-18-44411, revision 2, December 2018), sponsored by the DOE Office of Nuclear Energy. The 37-page PDF is available free from OSTI with the DOI 10.2172/1505628; no licence is named for this US government report. Caveats: the authors note the list is not all inclusive and relies on open sources, and it ends in 2017. It supports cyber threat scenarios for energy, water and industrial control system risk studies; a related record is the multi-domain incidents dataset for critical infrastructure.
